project.name: Scoonie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 11 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Leven beach, cafés, parks, parking and toilets remain with Leven. The related cross-boundary trail does not inflate Scoonie’s town score.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Scoonie’s old parish church and churchyard supply real heritage interest and the Leven–Lower Largo trail passes nearby, but Scoonie is not a rounded destination independent of Leven and remains selector-only.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.

visitorHighlights.name: Scoonie Old Parish Church and Churchyard
visitorHighlights.reason: The surviving old parish church and burial ground preserve medieval and later parish history on Scoonie Brae.
